app%20hay%20una%20**p%C3%A1gina%20de%20bienvenida**%20que%20explica%20la%20propuesta%20con%20frases%20cortas%20y%20%20un%20bot%C3%B3n%20para%20empezar.%20-%20El%20usuario%20puede%20**crear%20una%20cuenta%20o%20entrar**%20con%20su%20correo%20y%20contrase%C3%B1a%2C%20o%20directamente%20%20**con%20su%20cuenta%20de%20Google**.%20-%20La%20primera%20vez%20que%20entra%2C%20le%20llevas%20por%20un%20**proceso%20de%20bienvenida%20de%203%20pasos**%20para%20%20configurar%20su%20negocio%3A%20%201.%20**Sus%20datos%3A**%20nombre%20o%20raz%C3%B3n%20social%2C%20NIF%2FCIF%2C%20tel%C3%A9fono%2C%20direcci%C3%B3n%20y%20ciudad.%20%202.%20**Su%20marca%3A**%20subir%20su%20logo%20y%20elegir%20un%20color%20principal%20(por%20defecto%20un%20naranja%2C%20%60%23FF5C39%60).%20%203.%20**Sus%20preferencias%3A**%20el%20IVA%20que%20usa%20habitualmente%20y%20c%C3%B3mo%20quiere%20numerar%20sus%20documentos%20%20(por%20ejemplo%2C%20los%20presupuestos%20empiezan%20por%20%22P-2026%22%20y%20las%20facturas%20por%20%22F-2026%22).%20-%20Cuando%20termina%20esta%20configuraci%C3%B3n%2C%20ya%20puede%20empezar%20a%20usar%20la%20app.%20Sus%20datos%20quedan%20%20guardados%20para%20que%20aparezcan%20autom%C3%A1ticamente%20en%20todos%20sus%20documentos.%20---%20%20%23%23%20La%20pantalla%20principal%20%20Despu%C3%A9s%20de%20entrar%2C%20el%20usuario%20ve%20una%20pantalla%20limpia%20que%20le%20pregunta%20**%22%C2%BFQu%C3%A9%20necesitas%20hoy%3F%22**.%20%20Ah%C3%AD%20puede%3A%20-%20Elegir%20si%20quiere%20hacer%20un%20**presupuesto**%20o%20una%20**factura**%20(con%20un%20interruptor%20sencillo%20entre%20%20las%20dos%20opciones).%20-%20Pulsar%20un%20bot%C3%B3n%20grande%20para%20empezar%20uno%20nuevo.%20-%20Ver%20una%20lista%20con%20sus%20**documentos%20recientes**%20(los%20%C3%BAltimos%20que%20ha%20creado)%2C%20con%20el%20nombre%20del%20%20cliente%2C%20el%20n%C3%BAmero%2C%20la%20fecha%20y%20el%20total.%20Al%20tocar%20cualquiera%2C%20se%20abre%20para%20verlo%20o%20editarlo.%20---%20%20%23%23%20Paso%20previo%3A%20elegir%20el%20cliente%20%20Antes%20de%20dictar%2C%20el%20usuario%20tiene%20que%20decir%20**para%20qu%C3%A9%20cliente**%20es%20el%20documento.%20En%20esta%20%20pantalla%3A%20-%20Puede%20**buscar**%20entre%20sus%20clientes%20guardados%20(por%20nombre%2C%20NIF%20o%20correo).%20-%20Puede%20**crear%20un%20cliente%20nuevo**%20rellenando%20una%20ficha%20r%C3%A1pida%20(nombre%20obligatorio%3B%20NIF%2C%20%20tel%C3%A9fono%2C%20direcci%C3%B3n%20y%20correo%20opcionales).%20Una%20vez%20creado%2C%20queda%20guardado%20para%20la%20pr%C3%B3xima%20vez.%20-%20Al%20elegir%20un%20cliente%2C%20pasa%20directamente%20a%20la%20pantalla%20de%20dictado.%20---%20%20%23%23%20El%20coraz%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20app%3A%20dictar%20%20Esta%20es%20la%20pantalla%20m%C3%A1s%20importante%20y%20tiene%20que%20sentirse%20m%C3%A1gica%20y%20muy%20f%C3%A1cil%3A%20-%20Arriba%20se%20ve%20**el%20cliente%20elegido**%2C%20con%20la%20opci%C3%B3n%20de%20cambiarlo%20si%20se%20equivoc%C3%B3.%20-%20En%20el%20centro%20hay%20un%20**bot%C3%B3n%20redondo%20grande**%20con%20un%20micr%C3%B3fono.%20El%20usuario%20lo%20pulsa%20para%20%20empezar%20a%20grabar%20y%20lo%20vuelve%20a%20pulsar%20para%20terminar.%20-%20**Mientras%20graba**%2C%20el%20bot%C3%B3n%20debe%20estar%20vivo%3A%20anillos%20que%20laten%20alrededor%2C%20unas%20barras%20que%20se%20%20mueven%20al%20ritmo%20de%20su%20voz%2C%20y%20un%20cron%C3%B3metro%20que%20cuenta%20los%20segundos.%20As%C3%AD%20el%20usuario%20tiene%20la%20%20seguridad%20de%20que%20le%20est%C3%A1%20escuchando.%20-%20**Cuando%20termina%20de%20hablar**%2C%20la%20app%20se%20pone%20a%20trabajar%20y%20muestra%20un%20mensaje%20que%20va%20%20cambiando%20para%20que%20el%20usuario%20no%20se%20impaciente%3A%20*%22Transcribiendo%E2%80%A6%22*%2C%20luego%20%20*%22Estructurando%E2%80%A6%22*%2C%20y%20luego%20*%22Generando%20documento%E2%80%A6%22*.%20-%20En%20pocos%20segundos%2C%20le%20lleva%20directamente%20al%20documento%20ya%20generado.%20%20**C%C3%B3mo%20debe%20interpretar%20lo%20que%20el%20usuario%20dice**%20(esto%20es%20clave%20para%20que%20el%20resultado%20sea%20%20bueno)%3A%20-%20Si%20dice%20un%20precio%20%22en%20euros%22%20sin%20aclarar%20nada%2C%20se%20entiende%20que%20es%20**sin%20IVA**%2C%20y%20se%20le%20aplica%20el%20%20IVA%20habitual%20del%20usuario.%20-%20Si%20dice%20cosas%20como%20%22dos%20d%C3%ADas%22%20o%20%22dos%20sesiones%22%2C%20eso%20es%20la%20**cantidad**.%20-%20Si%20dice%20un%20precio%20total%20(%22800%20euros%20por%20dos%20d%C3%ADas%22)%2C%20la%20app%20reparte%20y%20calcula%20el%20precio%20por%20unidad.%20%20-%20Si%20menciona%20un%20plazo%20(%22plazo%207%20d%C3%ADas%22%2C%20%22validez%20una%20semana%22)%2C%20calcula%20la%20fecha%20de%20vencimiento%20%20sumando%20esos%20d%C3%ADas%20a%20la%20fecha%20de%20hoy.%20-%20La%20app%20debe%20ser%20**prudente**%3A%20nunca%20inventa%20datos.%20Si%20no%20ha%20o%C3%ADdo%20algo%20con%20claridad%2C%20%20simplemente%20lo%20deja%20en%20blanco%20para%20que%20el%20usuario%20lo%20complete%20despu%C3%A9s.%20-%20**Los%20totales%20los%20calcula%20siempre%20la%20propia%20app**%2C%20con%20cuidado%2C%20sin%20fiarse%20de%20lo%20que%20diga%20la%20voz%2C%20%20para%20que%20las%20cuentas%20nunca%20fallen.%20-%20Si%20no%20consigue%20entender%20nada%20(audio%20vac%C3%ADo%20o%20ininteligible)%2C%20avisa%20con%20un%20mensaje%20amable%3A%20*%22No%20%20te%20o%C3%ADmos%20bien%2C%20prueba%20de%20nuevo.%22*%20%20Cada%20documento%20recibe%20autom%C3%A1ticamente%20un%20**n%C3%BAmero%20correlativo**%20seg%C3%BAn%20la%20serie%20del%20usuario%20%20(por%20ejemplo%20P-2026-001%2C%20P-2026-002%2C%20etc.)%2C%20sin%20repetirse%20nunca.%20---%20%20%23%23%20Ver%2C%20corregir%20y%20descargar%20el%20documento%20%20Tras%20dictar%2C%20el%20usuario%20llega%20a%20la%20pantalla%20del%20documento%2C%20dividida%20en%20dos%20partes%3A%20-%20A%20un%20lado%2C%20un%20**panel%20para%20editar**%20por%20si%20algo%20hay%20que%20ajustar%3A%20los%20datos%20del%20cliente%2C%20las%20l%C3%ADneas%20%20(concepto%2C%20cantidad%2C%20precio%20e%20IVA%20de%20cada%20una%2C%20con%20opci%C3%B3n%20de%20a%C3%B1adir%20o%20quitar%20l%C3%ADneas)%2C%20las%20fechas%20%20y%20las%20notas.%20Recuerda%3A%20esto%20es%20solo%20para%20**corregir**%20lo%20que%20se%20dict%C3%B3%2C%20no%20para%20crear%20desde%20cero.%20-%20Al%20otro%20lado%2C%20**el%20documento%20tal%20y%20como%20quedar%C3%A1%20en%20PDF**%2C%20con%20la%20marca%20del%20usuario.%20-%20Cualquier%20cambio%20que%20haga%20**se%20guarda%20solo**%2C%20sin%20tener%20que%20pulsar%20%22guardar%22.%20-%20Arriba%20tiene%20los%20botones%20para%3A%20**descargar%20el%20PDF**%2C%20**eliminar**%20el%20documento%2C%20y%20%E2%80%94si%20es%20un%20%20presupuesto%E2%80%94%20**convertirlo%20en%20factura**%20con%20un%20solo%20clic%20(se%20crea%20una%20factura%20nueva%20con%20los%20%20mismos%20datos%20y%20su%20propio%20n%C3%BAmero).%20-%20Tambi%C3%A9n%20puede%20activar%20un%20interruptor%20para%20**ocultar%20el%20logo**%20en%20el%20documento%20si%20lo%20prefiere.%20%20El%20PDF%20que%20se%20descarga%20debe%20verse%20profesional%2C%20en%20tama%C3%B1o%20folio%20(A4)%2C%20con%20el%20nombre%20del%20%20archivo%20tipo%20%22presupuesto-P-2026-001.pdf%22.%20---%20%20%23%23%20El%20aspecto%20de%20los%20documentos%20%20El%20usuario%20puede%20elegir%20entre%20**cuatro%20estilos%20de%20plantilla**%20para%20sus%20presupuestos%20y%20facturas%2C%20y%20%20verlos%20antes%20de%20decidir%3A%20-%20**Cl%C3%A1sico%3A**%20sobrio%20y%20profesional%2C%20con%20un%20toque%20del%20color%20de%20su%20marca.%20-%20**Minimal%3A**%20blanco%20y%20negro%2C%20muy%20limpio%2C%20sin%20distracciones.%20-%20**Moderno%3A**%20con%20una%20banda%20de%20color%20llamativa%20arriba%20y%20tipograf%C3%ADa%20fuerte.%20-%20**Editorial%3A**%20elegante%2C%20con%20tipograf%C3%ADa%20tipo%20revista%2C%20estilo%20papel.%20%20Todos%20los%20documentos%20deben%20incluir%3A%20los%20datos%20del%20negocio%20y%20su%20logo%20arriba%2C%20los%20datos%20del%20%20cliente%2C%20una%20tabla%20con%20las%20l%C3%ADneas%2C%20el%20desglose%20del%20IVA%2C%20el%20total%20bien%20destacado%2C%20las%20notas%20si%20las%20%20hay%2C%20y%20un%20pie%20discreto.%20---%20%20%23%23%20Ajustes%20%20Una%20secci%C3%B3n%20donde%20el%20usuario%20puede%20cambiar%20en%20cualquier%20momento%3A%20-%20**Sus%20datos%20de%20empresa**%20(nombre%2C%20NIF%2C%20direcci%C3%B3n%2C%20ciudad%2C%20tel%C3%A9fono%2C%20correo).%20-%20**Su%20marca**%20(cambiar%20el%20logo%20y%20el%20color%20principal).%20-%20**Su%20numeraci%C3%B3n%20y%20preferencias**%20(las%20series%20de%20presupuestos%20y%20facturas%2C%20el%20IVA%20por%20defecto%20y%20%20la%20moneda).%20-%20**El%20estilo%20de%20plantilla**%20que%20quiere%20usar.%20---%20%20%23%23%20El%20estilo%20general%20de%20la%20app%20%20Quiero%20que%20la%20interfaz%20se%20sienta%20**limpia%2C%20c%C3%A1lida%20y%20profesional**%2C%20en%20la%20l%C3%ADnea%20de%20apps%20como%20Linear%20%20o%20las%20Notas%20de%20Apple.%20Fondo%20blanco%20roto%20c%C3%A1lido%2C%20textos%20en%20gris%20muy%20oscuro%20casi%20negro%2C%20y%20el%20%20naranja%20de%20marca%20para%20los%20botones%20y%20acentos%20importantes.%20Las%20esquinas%20redondeadas%20y%20%20suaves.%20Los%20n%C3%BAmeros%20y%20cifras%20deben%20verse%20ordenados%20y%20alineados.%20El%20bot%C3%B3n%20de%20grabar%20debe%20%20tener%20una%20animaci%C3%B3n%20bonita%20de%20anillos%20que%20laten.%20Quiero%20que%20tenga%20tambi%C3%A9n%20una%20versi%C3%B3n%20en%20%20modo%20oscuro.%20---%20%20%23%23%20Por%20d%C3%B3nde%20empezar%20%20Lo%20primero%20y%20m%C3%A1s%20importante%20que%20tiene%20que%20funcionar%20perfecto%20es%20este%20recorrido%3A%20**entrar%20%E2%86%92%20%20elegir%20cliente%20%E2%86%92%20dictar%20%E2%86%92%20ver%20el%20PDF%20generado**.%20Si%20ese%20momento%20funciona%20y%20se%20siente%20m%C3%A1gico%2C%20%20el%20resto%20de%20la%20app%20gira%20en%20t%20" target="_blank" class="bg-blue-950/60 hover:bg-blue-900 text-blue-400 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-blue-800/40 transition">Copilot</a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
    </main>

    <!-- Modal para Crear / Editar Prompt -->
    <div id="promptModal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm hidden items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
        <div class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4">
            <h2 id="modalTitleText" class="text-lg font-bold text-sky-400">Crear Nuevo Prompt</h2>
            <form id="promptForm" onsubmit="savePrompt(event)" class="space-y-4">
                <input type="hidden" id="modalPromptId">
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-1">Título</label>
                    <input type="text" id="modalTitle" required="" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500">
                </div>
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-1">Categoría</label>
                    <select id="modalCategorySelect" required="" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500"><option value="">-- Seleccione una categoría --</option><option value="Dirección">Dirección</option><option value="Ventas">Ventas</option><option value="Marketing">Marketing</option><option value="Operaciones">Operaciones</option><option value="Producto">Producto</option><option value="Finanzas">Finanzas</option><option value="RRHH">RRHH</option><option value="Derecho">Derecho</option><option value="Tecnología">Tecnología</option><option value="Otros">Otros</option></select>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-1">Contenido del Prompt (Puede pegar texto libremente)</label>
                    <textarea id="modalContent" rows="6" required="" class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500 resize-none"></textarea>
                </div>
                <div class="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
                    <button type="button" onclick="closeModal()" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition">Cancelar</button>
                    <button type="submit" class="bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-lg transition font-medium">Guardar</button>
                </div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Script de Gestión -->
    <script>
        const FIXED_CATEGORIES = ['Dirección', 'Ventas', 'Marketing', 'Operaciones', 'Producto', 'Finanzas', 'RRHH', 'Derecho', 'Tecnología', 'Otros'];

        let prompts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user_prompts')) || [
            { id: 1, title: 'Estructura de Experto', category: 'Dirección', date: '26/09/2026', content: 'Actúa como un experto en ingeniería de prompt y programación web...' },
            { id: 2, title: 'Análisis de Datos con IA', category: 'Tecnología', date: '26/09/2026', content: 'Procesa el siguiente conjunto de datos y genera métricas clave...' }
        ];

        let activeFileName = localStorage.getItem('active_excel_name') || 'Ninguno';

        function init() {
            document.getElementById('fileNameDisplay').innerText = `Archivo activo: ${activeFileName}`;
            renderCategories();
            renderModalCategories();
            filterAndSortPrompts();
        }

        function renderPrompts(data) {
            const grid = document.getElementById('promptsGrid');
            if (!data || data.length === 0) {
                grid.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full text-center py-12 text-slate-500">No hay prompts disponibles con los filtros actuales.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            grid.innerHTML = data.map(p => {
                const encodedPrompt = encodeURIComponent(p.content || '');
                return `
                <div class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-lg hover:border-slate-700 transition">
                    <div class="space-y-3">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-start gap-2">
                            <span class="bg-sky-950 text-sky-400 text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full font-medium border border-sky-800/50">${p.category || 'Otros'}</span>
                            <span class="text-xs text-slate-500">${p.date || ''}</span>
                        </div>
                        <h3 class="font-bold text-slate-200 text-lg">${p.title || 'Sin título'}</h3>
                        <p class="text-sm text-slate-400 line-clamp-3 bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/50 font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap">${p.content || ''}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-slate-800 flex flex-col gap-3">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <button onclick="copyToClipboard(${p.id})" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span>📋</span> Copiar
                                </button>
                                <button onclick="openEditModal(${p.id})" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-sky-400 text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <span>✏️</span> Editar
                                </button>
                            </div>
                            <button onclick="deletePrompt(${p.id})" class="text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 text-xs px-2 py-1 transition">Eliminar</button>
                        </div>
                        <!-- Enlaces directos a las IAs -->
                        <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/60 text-xs">
                            <span class="text-slate-500 font-medium mr-1">Probar en:</span>
                            <a href="https://gemini.google.com/app?q=${encodedPrompt}" target="_blank" class="bg-sky-950/60 hover:bg-sky-900 text-sky-400 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-sky-800/40 transition">Gemini</a>
                            <a href="https://chatgpt.com/?q=${encodedPrompt}" target="_blank" class="bg-emerald-950/60 hover:bg-emerald-900 text-emerald-400 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-emerald-800/40 transition">ChatGPT</a>
                            <a href="https://claude.ai/new?q=${encodedPrompt}" target="_blank" class="bg-amber-950/60 hover:bg-amber-900 text-amber-400 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-amber-800/40 transition">Claude</a>
                            <a href="https://copilot.microsoft.com/?q=${encodedPrompt}" target="_blank" class="bg-blue-950/60 hover:bg-blue-900 text-blue-400 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-blue-800/40 transition">Copilot</a>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function renderCategories() {
            const select = document.getElementById('categoryFilter');
            const currentSelected = select.value;
            select.innerHTML = `<option value="">Todas las categorías</option>` + 
                FIXED_CATEGORIES.map(c => `<option value="${c}" ${c === currentSelected ? 'selected' : ''}>${c}</option>`).join('');
        }

        function renderModalCategories() {
            const select = document.getElementById('modalCategorySelect');
            select.innerHTML = `<option value="">-- Seleccione una categoría --</option>` + 
                FIXED_CATEGORIES.map(c => `<option value="${c}">${c}</option>`).join('');
        }

        function filterAndSortPrompts() {
            const query = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
            const category = document.getElementById('categoryFilter').value;
            const sortOrder = document.getElementById('sortOrder').value;

            let filtered = prompts.filter(p => {
                const matchesQuery = (p.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
                                     (p.content || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) || 
                                     (p.category || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
                const matchesCategory = category === "" || p.category === category;
                return matchesQuery && matchesCategory;
            });

            filtered.sort((a, b) => {
                const titleA = (a.title || '').toLowerCase();
                const titleB = (b.title || '').toLowerCase();
                if (sortOrder === 'az') {
                    return titleA.localeCompare(titleB);
                } else if (sortOrder === 'za') {
                    return titleB.localeCompare(titleA);
                } else if (sortOrder === 'reciente') {
                    return b.id - a.id;
                }
            });

            renderPrompts(filtered);
        }

        function importExcel(e) {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            activeFileName = file.name;
            localStorage.setItem('active_excel_name', activeFileName);

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(evt) {
                try {
                    const data = new Uint8Array(evt.target.result);
                    const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
                    const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[workbook.SheetNames[0]];
                    const jsonRows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet);

                    const imported = jsonRows.map((row, index) => ({
                        id: Date.now() + index,
                        title: row.Titulo || row.Título || row.title || 'Sin título',
                        category: row.Categoria || row.Categoría || row.category || 'Otros',
                        date: row.Fecha || row.date || new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-ES'),
                        content: row.Prompt || row.prompt || row.Contenido || ''
                    }));

                    if (imported.length > 0) {
                        prompts = [...imported];
                        localStorage.setItem('user_prompts', JSON.stringify(prompts));
                        init();
                        alert(`¡Se cargaron ${imported.length} prompts correctamente desde "${activeFileName}"!`);
                    } else {
                        alert('El archivo no contiene registros válidos.');
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    alert('Error al procesar el archivo.');
                }
            };
            reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
        }

        function openModal() {
            renderModalCategories();
            document.getElementById('modalTitleText').innerText = "Crear Nuevo Prompt";
            document.getElementById('modalPromptId').value = "";
            document.getElementById('promptForm').reset();
            document.getElementById('promptModal').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('promptModal').classList.add('flex');
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').focus();
        }

        function openEditModal(id) {
            const promptObj = prompts.find(p => p.id === id);
            if (!promptObj) return;

            renderModalCategories();
            document.getElementById('modalTitleText').innerText = "Editar Prompt";
            document.getElementById('modalPromptId').value = promptObj.id;
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').value = promptObj.title || '';
            document.getElementById('modalCategorySelect').value = promptObj.category || 'Otros';
            document.getElementById('modalContent').value = promptObj.content || '';

            document.getElementById('promptModal').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('promptModal').classList.add('flex');
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').focus();
        }

        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('promptModal').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('promptModal').classList.remove('flex');
            document.getElementById('promptForm').reset();
        }

        function savePrompt(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const idInput = document.getElementById('modalPromptId').value;
            const title = document.getElementById('modalTitle').value;
            const category = document.getElementById('modalCategorySelect').value;
            const content = document.getElementById('modalContent').value;
            const date = new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });

            if (idInput) {
                const index = prompts.findIndex(p => p.id == idInput);
                if (index !== -1) {
                    prompts[index] = { ...prompts[index], title, category, content };
                }
                alert('¡Prompt actualizado con éxito!');
            } else {
                prompts.unshift({ id: Date.now(), title, category, date, content });
                alert('¡Prompt creado con éxito!');
            }

            localStorage.setItem('user_prompts', JSON.stringify(prompts));
            init();
            closeModal();
        }

        function deletePrompt(id) {
            if (confirm('¿Desea eliminar este prompt?')) {
                prompts = prompts.filter(p => p.id !== id);
                localStorage.setItem('user_prompts', JSON.stringify(prompts));
                init();
            }
        }

        function copyToClipboard(id) {
            const promptObj = prompts.find(p => p.id === id);
            if (!promptObj) return;
            const text = promptObj.content || '';

            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
                    alert('¡Prompt copiado al portapapeles!');
                }).catch(() => {
                    fallbackCopyText(text);
                });
            } else {
                fallbackCopyText(text);
            }
        }

        function fallbackCopyText(text) {
            const textArea = document.createElement("textarea");
            textArea.value = text;
            textArea.style.position = "fixed";
            textArea.style.top = "0";
            textArea.style.left = "0";
            textArea.style.opacity = "0";
            document.body.appendChild(textArea);
            textArea.focus();
            textArea.select();
            try {
                const successful = document.execCommand('copy');
                if (successful) {
                    alert('¡Prompt copiado al portapapeles!');
                } else {
                    alert('No se pudo copiar el texto automáticamente.');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                alert('Error al intentar copiar.');
            }
            document.body.removeChild(textArea);
        }

        function exportToExcel() {
            const dataToExport = prompts.map(p => ({
                Titulo: p.title,
                Categoria: p.category,
                Fecha: p.date,
                Prompt: p.content
            }));

            const worksheet = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(dataToExport);
            const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new();
            XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, worksheet, "Prompts");

            const fileName = activeFileName !== 'Ninguno' ? activeFileName.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, "") + "_actualizado.xlsx" : "Banco_de_Prompts_Tito_Aponte.xlsx";
            XLSX.writeFile(workbook, fileName);
        }

        window.onload = init;
    </script>

</body></html>
